automation.name: Automate event cards
automation.hint: Carry out revealed event cards automatically: the controlling player chooses on their own screen (the GM decides if they are offline or don't answer within a minute), the board is updated and the card is disposed of. Turn this off to resolve events by hand from the chat card.

status.waiting: Waiting for {user} to choose for {faction} ({s} s per step)…
status.fallback: {user} did not answer in time: the GM chooses for {faction}.
status.failed: The automation could not finish ({error}). Carry the event out by hand.
status.noCard: Dry run: no event card was used.

notify.fallback: {user} did not answer the event for {faction}: you choose.

error.notAutomated: There is no automation for the event "{id}".

reason.tie: tie for the largest population ({names}: {n} each).
reason.noPopulation: no faction controls a city (nobody has a population).
reason.noWar: no faction is playing a war.
reason.noFallout: there is no fallout territory on the board.

ask.timer: You have {s} seconds; after that the GM decides.

prompt.city: pick one of your cities ({n} troops)
prompt.maneuverCount: How many troops move from {from} to {to}?
prompt.split: pick a city for your troops ({n} left)
prompt.splitCount: How many troops go to {territory}? ({n} left)
prompt.unoccupiedCity: pick an unoccupied city territory ({n} troops)
prompt.minorCity: pick the Minor City to ruin

control_the_people.prompt: gain troops in one of your cities, or make an immediate maneuver.
control_the_people.troops: +{n} troops in one city you control
control_the_people.maneuverHint: Between connected territories you control; leave one troop behind.

fortify.prompt: fortify one of your cities, or add troops to up to two of them.
fortify.fortify: Fortify one of your cities (DESTROYS this card)
fortify.troops: +{n} troops in each of up to two cities

resistance.none: No Minor City holds 1 or 2 troops.

join_the_cause.prompt: receive troops in your cities, or choose a new mission.
join_the_cause.troops: Receive {n} troops in one or more of your cities
join_the_cause.mission: Choose a new mission from the mission deck
join_the_cause.missionHint: The current mission is discarded and the deck reshuffled.

beam_down.prompt: you may place troops into one unoccupied city territory.
beam_down.none: There is no unoccupied city territory: nothing happens.

die_humans.prompt: you may ruin a Minor City: its troops are removed and any HQ there is demolished.
die_humans.ruin: Ruin a Minor City (DESTROYS this card)
die_humans.none: There is no Minor City on the board: nothing happens.
die_humans.done: {faction} ruins {name} in {territory}. That city is gone.

mysterious_island.prompt: you may take any one face-up territory card. If an even card is turned over in slot 1, another event occurs.
mysterious_island.none: There are no face-up territory cards.

agent_of_chaos.blocked: A human faction holds a continent bonus: the Mutants collect nothing.
agent_of_chaos.done: {faction} collect one Red Star token ({total} / 4 Red Stars).

fallout.none: No troops stand next to the fallout territory.

prompt.approach: do the Mutants evolve OFFENSIVELY or DEFENSIVELY?
prompt.target: what evolves on the Mutants: their BODIES or their BRAINS?

mutants_evolve.noChoice: No choice was made: scratch the card by hand.
mutants_evolve.done: {faction} evolve: {choice}. The choice is scratched off and the card is kept.
mutants_evolve.scratch: Both Mutants Evolve cards are scratched: scratch off the {code} box on the {faction} faction card.
